mapper.insert: insert into qq_group_reply_config (group_id, group_name, enabled) values (#{groupId}, coalesce(cast(#{groupName} as text), 'QQ群 ' || cast(#{groupId} as text)), true) on conflict (group_id) do update set group_name = excluded.group_name where cast(#{groupName} as text) is not null and qq_group_reply_config.group_name is distinct from excluded.group_name
mapper.select: select group_id, group_name, enabled from qq_group_reply_config order by group_id
